_doc: Hub and landmark site prefabs on the walkable globe (SiteBuilders; built by the definition's sites_script). sites: [{id, kind (hub | landmark), name, size_m (pad diameter), clear_core_m (junk-free core, default 12), start_only (true: only hub 0 gets it; the other hubs cycle through the rest), desc}], hubs first. Optional: hub_pad_m (flat pad radius of hubs after the first, default 82), fill_pad (the builder gets the pad's flat radius as opts.flat), yard_keep_out (the start yard keeps junk off its pad piece by piece), api (a note on the script's entry point).
api: Placeable site prefabs for the walkable globe (planets/tidewell/sites.gd): TideSite.place(id, root, stage 0-2, restoration 0-1, {water_radius, seed}); a local flat patch about 60-100 m across, sea level at y = 0.14, no world-origin assumptions. Preview: res://planets/tidewell/site_preview.tscn -- --site=<id>.

sites.name: Anchored Raft
sites.desc: Timber raft deck on rusted pontoons: workshop shack, store, deck crane, fuel tank, moorings.

sites.name: Stilt Yard
sites.desc: A sandy islet with a stilt deck and huts over the water, boardwalk, beached skiff.

sites.name: Ore Barge Wreck
sites.desc: The Ledger's half-sunk mining barge by a sandbar; hoppers turn to planters when restored.

sites.name: Dredge Rig
sites.desc: A Ledger jack-up dredging rig with bucket ladder, derrick and crane.

sites.name: Reef Garden
sites.desc: Bleached coral breaking the surface among nets; live coral and floating gardens when restored.

sites.name: Buoy Field
sites.desc: Rows of mooring buoys strung with rope and ghost nets; light caps when futuristic.
